authentication: Loopback-only application behind trusted operator identity proxy; explicit --dev-user for local development only
run_scope: An explicitly selected run must belong to the selected team
manual_window: Monday 00:00 UTC to the selected Monday 00:00 UTC; omitted API/CLI run_at selects the latest completed week
execution_lock: Database SQL session lock alerts-bi-weekly shared by manual HTTP/API and CLI runs, standalone CLI reports, weekly scheduling and deletion; held across scan, persistence and report writing, including model-off runs; standalone reports hold it before run-id/team lookup through the final file write; durable manual jobs also use this full-lifecycle lock
deletion: Actor-bound same-site CSRF and confirm_delete=1; removes the run and run-owned records; shared caches remain
deployment: One UI replica/application worker, one dedicated manual run-worker; login proxy is the only service port
execution_runtime: Maintained alerts_bi_admin.engine source in the admin distribution; no runs package or listener

async_submission.concurrency: One active manual job; SQL session lock and active slot constraint; busy returns 409

synchronous_response: JSON summary and three CSV links; no HTML content negotiation or scorecard field
